findings.message: Positive eval prompts look synthetic. Rewrite more prompts as realistic user utterances.
Examples look abstract or template-like. Prefer realistic user requests and concrete workflows.
Skill/package scope may be too broad for a first pass. Add explicit guidance like 'start with 2-3 focused surfaces' or 'keep scope tight'.
Network usage detected in scripts without an explicit domain/host allowlist policy in SKILL.md.
Hard-coded URL(s) detected in scripts; document explicit allowed domains/hosts in SKILL.md.
No deterministic risky-command guard detected. Add forbidden command checks (e.g., curl/wget/rm -rf/netcat).
No negative/non-trigger security case detected in evals.yaml. Add `category: negative` or `should_trigger: false` coverage.
No prompt-injection/jailbreak-style prompt detected in evals.yaml. Add one adversarial PI prompt case.
No pressure/adversarial case detected in evals.yaml. Add at least one `category: pressure` case.
